description: Implementation of the KeyIdMap class managing key session IDs and associated key IDs with thread safety, including singleton pattern access, add, update, get, and erase operations.

classes.name: KeyIdMap
classes.description: Singleton class managing a thread-safe map of session IDs to key IDs.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of KeyIdMap.

methods.name: addSession
methods.description: Adds a new session with the given session ID, initializing its key ID to an empty vector.

methods.name: updateKey
methods.description: Updates the key ID associated with a given session ID; returns true if successful.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the key ID associated with a given session ID; returns an empty vector if not found.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes the session ID and its associated key ID from the map.
